 08Th May, 2025

 Versus

High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Pradeep Lohani, Brief Holder.

Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
This is the Second Anticipatory Bail Application.

2. The First Anticipatory Bail Application (Aba No.306 of 2025) was dismissed as withdrawn on
29.04.2025 granting liberty to the applicant to file a fresh anticipatory bail application.

3.  This Application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.375 of 2024, registered at Kotwali Roorkee, District Haridwar under Sections 120B, 420, 467, 468, 471 and Section 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
4.
As per the First Information Report dated 09.06.2024, the informant entered into an agreement with the applicant to purchase the property-in-question.
The applicant made that agreement at a very high price.
5. Heard Ms. Sadaf, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Pradeep Lohani, learned Brief Holder for the State.
6. Ms. Sadaf, Advocate, for the applicant submitted that the applicant is the owner of the property and he is still ready to sell the property to the informant.
7. Learned counsel for the State has sought two weeks' time to file objection to the anticipatory bail application.

sentences.text:
9. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant Noor Hasan, aged about 60 years, he shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/-
and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
10. List on 23.05.2025 for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Date:08.05.2025 Pant/
